reasons.post-harvest-reset: Upstream clears age, volume and salvage volume but retains height, ECA, crown closure, basal area and QMD until subsequent growth (upstream-forestryCastor.R:644,685,703). The browser immediately resets the harvested stand attributes (engine.ts:466-475).
reasons.salvage-raster-volume: Upstream harvestBlocksVolume writes live vol_h even for dead harvest (upstream-forestryCastor.R:720-722); native dead-harvest reporting uses salvage volume at lines 691-697. The browser raster records actual harvested dead volume (engine.ts:462,570,591).
reasons.candidate-cap: Upstream LIMIT trunc(target/50) excludes all candidates in this low-volume fixture (upstream-forestryCastor.R:585-593). The browser traverses the full eligible queue, affecting harvest and subsequent state/reports (engine.ts:665-708).
reasons.final-yield-endpoint: Without an upper interpolation knot upstream retains previous/input attributes (upstream-growingStockCastor.R:94-107,165-178). The browser holds the last supplied endpoint (growth.ts:16-20,45-51).
reasons.maximum-age-clamp: Upstream increments 349 to 351 and then excludes the cell from growth interpolation (upstream-growingStockCastor.R:159-165). The browser clamps age to 350 and updates yield (engine.ts:376-379).
reasons.scheduled-constraint-enforcement: Upstream followSchedule bypasses setConstraints (upstream-forestryCastor.R:93-100). The browser evaluates and enforces constraints, affecting selection, later state and reports (engine.ts:382-383,535-546,770).
